name: God's Own Country Kitchen
signature_dish: Butter-garlic crab and prawn moilee with a clifftop sea view
why_it_matters: A clifftop Kerala-and-seafood restaurant right on Varkala's North Cliff, repeatedly named the best seafood spot on the strip. The kitchen does the Kerala classics — butter-garlic crab, prawn moilee, fresh catch of the day — and runs live music most nights, with the Arabian Sea straight ahead.
insider_tip: Come for sunset and the live music. Service can be slow and bills should be checked, as on much of the Cliff — but the seafood and the view are the reason to be here. Pick your fish fresh.
signature_address: God's Own Country Kitchen, North Cliff, Varkala, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695141

name: Cafe del Mar
signature_dish: Seafood tagliatelle and grilled tiger prawns overlooking the cliff
why_it_matters: A long-running multi-cuisine restaurant perched on Varkala's North Cliff, often cited as one of the best on the strip. It does a wide breakfast-to-dinner menu but is best known for seafood — chunky seafood tagliatelle, good-quality grilled tiger prawns — eaten over the clifftop view.
insider_tip: Not the cheapest on the Cliff, but portions are generous. Food can take time; the cliff-edge tables and the sea view are worth the wait. Good for a sit-down dinner rather than a quick bite.
signature_address: Cafe del Mar, North Cliff, Varkala, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695141

name: Cafe Italiano
signature_dish: Wood-fired seafood pizza and Italian dishes with a North Cliff beach view
why_it_matters: A North Cliff cafe with a stunning beach view, Cafe Italiano leans Italian — pizzas, pasta — but also handles Kerala seafood well, with prawns, tandoori fish, calamari and crab on the menu. A reliable, popular choice on the Varkala Cliff for travellers wanting Italian food with a sea view.
insider_tip: Go for the wood-fired pizza and fresh juices; the seafood pizza is the crowd-pleaser. Sea-view tables fill at sunset, so arrive early.
signature_address: Cafe Italiano, North Cliff, Varkala, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695141

name: Tibetan Kitchen
signature_dish: Momos and thukpa — Tibetan and Nepali cooking on the Cliff
why_it_matters: A small Tibetan-and-Nepali kitchen on Varkala's North Middle Cliff, well-regarded for momos and thukpa — a change of pace on a strip dominated by seafood and Italian. The food is fresh, the vegetables varied, and the juices are squeezed fresh, not bottled.
insider_tip: The momos are the reason to come — the cheese and spinach versions are favourites; order them with soup. A cosy, casual spot rather than a sea-view destination.
signature_address: Tibetan Kitchen, North Middle Cliff, Varkala, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695141

name: Clafouti Cafe
signature_dish: Daily fresh catch chosen at the counter and cooked to order, plus big breakfasts
why_it_matters: A popular North Cliff cafe attached to Clafouti Beach Resort, well-known for its breakfasts and its seafood — guests choose from the daily fresh catch and have it cooked to taste. One of the established names on the Varkala Cliff, mixing Indian and international dishes.
insider_tip: Strong for breakfast — the aloo paratha and big breakfast spreads are reliably good. For dinner, pick your fish from the day's catch. Sea-view tables go fast at sunset.
signature_address: Clafouti, North Cliff, Varkala, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695141
